PDF Volume Rendering Overview
1 Transform volume data to sheared object space by translating and resampling each slice (S). • Shear-Warp can be expressed as factorization of the view transform matrix: \( M_{view} = M_{warp2d} \cdot M_{shear3d} = M_{warp2d} \cdot S \cdot P \) - P permutes axes that so shear is parallel to slices that are most perpendicular to viewing ...
